decisions.decision: Board agreed to host a workshop at the Lunenburg Adult Activity Center on how property owners can file an appeal if an abatement application is denied.
decisions.quote: board members agreed they'd like to host a workshop at the lunenburg adult activity center informing property owners of how they could file an appeal if their abatement application is denied.

decisions.decision: Board agreed to create a float for the Lunenburg 300th Anniversary celebration and to feature something at the Lunenburg Adult Activity Center each month to commemorate the 300th anniversary.
decisions.quote: board members agreed they'd like to create a float to display, and also would like to feature something at the lunenburg adult activity center each month to commemorate the 300th anniversary of the town.
